title: Stitch launches AI-powered Pulse suite for payment analytics
ai_summary: Stitch launched Pulse, an AI-powered suite for payment analytics, starting with Pulse Analytics. The AI agent analyzes payment data, provides plain-language insights, and enables real-time alerts and actions. It will be rolled out to all existing Stitch payments clients, with additional products planned.

title: Stitch and CrissCross expand cross-border payments in South Africa
ai_summary: Stitch Group, a South Africa-based payments company, partnered with CrissCross FX to launch an international invoice payments service for enterprises. The service lets businesses settle invoices in USD and other G10 currencies via a single provider, with API access, faster turnaround, and competitive FX rates. Settlement occurs at T+0 or T+1, managed through a centralized dashboard.

title: Stitch enables real-time payments across South Africa’s major banks
ai_summary: South African payments infrastructure company Stitch has expanded its real-time payments offering by launching PayShap Request, aimed at enterprise businesses. The announcement does not disclose pricing, technical specifications, or the number of participating banks.

title: Stitch offers PayShap Request with smart routing infrastructure
ai_summary: South African payments infrastructure company Stitch has launched PayShap Request, a service enabling businesses to collect real-time payments directly from customers' banking apps. The platform utilizes PayInc's infrastructure and features a multi-acquirer architecture that provides redundancy and automated routing across major South African banks.

title: How Can One Card Manage Multiple Currency Wallets?
ai_summary: LuLu Exchange is building a multi-currency card program in the UAE to enhance cross-border payment transactions, facing operational challenges due to the need for a coordinated architecture. The company is collaborating with Stitch, which integrates multiple functions like issuing, processing, and reconciliation into a single operating layer to streamline its currency management processes. This initiative supports access to 26 currency wallets, enabling customers to transact more efficiently during travel, while also emphasizing the importance of adaptable operational structures in financial technology.

title: Fintech start-up Stitch adds PayShap Request
ai_summary: Stitch, a South African payments infrastructure provider, has gone live with PayShap Request, a real-time payment feature allowing enterprise businesses to collect payments across all major South African banks through redundant, consumer-centric routing. Several enterprise clients have already migrated to this new payments rail, which is accessible through Stitch's API without requiring a separate build. The company, which raised $107 million in total funding including a $55 million Series B in April 2025, operates offices in Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Lagos.
